descriptionHtml:
Technical Specifications

The Antec VISION 120R ARGB 3in1 is a premium set of three Reverse Blade fans. These are specifically designed for intake positions (like the bottom or side of panoramic cases such as the Antec C5 or C3) so that the "aesthetic" side of the fan faces the interior while still pulling air in.

FeatureSpecification
ModelVISION 120R ARGB (3-in-1 Pack)
Fan TypePWM Reverse Blade Fan
Dimensions120 x 120 x 25 mm
Bearing TypeHydraulic Bearing
Fan Speed600 – 1500 RPM ± 10%
AirflowUp to 58.7 CFM
Static PressureUp to 1.54 mmH2O
